name: json-to-markdown-table
purpose: Convert a JSON array in records.json to a Markdown table in table.md and report the number of data rows written.
instructions: Read the file records.json from the workspace. Parse its contents as a JSON array. If the file does not exist, cannot be read, or the parsed value is not an array, write nothing to table.md and output the word ERROR. If the array is empty, write a Markdown table that contains only the header row (derived from the keys of the first object if any, otherwise leave the header empty) and output the number 0. If the array contains one or more objects, assume all objects share the same set of keys in the same order. Create a Markdown table where the first row lists those keys, and each subsequent row lists the corresponding values in the same order. Write the complete table to table.md. After writing, output only the integer count of data rows (the number of objects in the array). Do not perform any other actions or output any additional text. The reply must contain only the required output, no extra formatting or commentary.
